text:
ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens, dark green to bright green, with some lighter green stems and thin reddish-pink stems radiating through the pile; ruffled, slightly glossy leaves with a moist sheen, spread across roughly 45% of the plate's upper-left area, about 15 cm across and 4 cm tall at the mound's peak | 85

ITEM 2 | Halved small round cucumber-like slices, pale green skin with darker green rim, cut faces showing pale flesh, about 3 cm across, sitting at the lower edge of the greens | 12

ITEM 3 | Small pale crumbles, white and off-white, scattered among the greens and near the cucumber, crumbly and matte, each piece about 0.3 to 0.5 cm | 6

ITEM 4 | Small dark purple-brown leaf fragments mixed into the greens, slightly glossy, about 1 to 2 cm long | 3

ITEM 5 | Pale white-green sliced piece, crisp-looking, about 2 cm long, at the bottom right edge beside the greens | 4
